### INITIALIZE\_PASS() {#af884214031cdb18344d85b5d4c422fef}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">INITIALIZE_PASS (AArch64RedundantCopyElimination, "aarch64-copyelim", "AArch64 redundant copy elimination pass", false, false)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>It's possible to determine the value of a register based on a dominating condition.</p>


<p>To do so, this function checks to see if the basic block <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MBB</span> is the target of a conditional branch <span class="doxyComputerOutput">CondBr</span> with an equality comparison. If the branch is a CBZ/CBNZ, we know the value of its source operand is zero in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MBB</span> for some cases. Otherwise, we find and inspect the NZCV setting instruction (e.g., SUBS, ADDS). If this instruction defines a register other than WZR/XZR, we know the value of the destination register is zero in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MMB</span> for some cases. In addition, if the NZCV setting instruction is comparing against a constant we know the other source register is equal to the constant in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MBB</span> for some cases. If we find any constant values, push a physical register and constant value pair onto the KnownRegs vector and return true. Otherwise, return false if no known values were found.</p>


<p>Definition at line 108 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/aarch64/aarch64redundantcopyelimination-cpp">AArch64RedundantCopyElimination.cpp</a>.</p>
